title: Double, Double, Toil and Trouble — The Cold Version #Shorts
description:
Modern psychology keeps rediscovering what the pessimists said first about Double, Double, Toil and Trouble. Double, Double, Toil and Trouble is a 1993 American Halloween made-for-television children's film. It stars Mary-Kate and Ashley Olsen as two adventurous little girls who discover that their Great Aunt Sophia has been trapped and cursed by her evil twin sister Agatha.

The self that experiences Double, Double, Toil and Trouble is a committee, not a king. She asks for help, but the twins say "no chance" and walk out of the attic while holding hands and the magic wand. In 1994, composer Richard Bellis received an Emmy Award nomination for Outstanding Individual Achievement in Music Composition for a Miniseries or a Special (Dramatic Underscore).
